[i]With the Dushkari computing industry still running on floppy disks, problems have been noticed when attempting to transfer data to something which Dushkari computers can use. Having spent considerable time and resources in something most countries abandoned, the floppy disks in use in Dushkaria is of course, not on the same level as your average cd but it can still hold more data than what your average floppy disk can. With some media needing more than two or three floppy disks, and not to mention needing to develop software to even make it run, it has slowly become a growing issue for Dushkaria if it ever seeks to import mass media.[/i]
